title: ASVAB
subtitle: Military aptitude
description: Start with the four AFQT subjects; technical subtests can be added later.

topics.title: Arithmetic Reasoning
topics.description: Use math to solve everyday word problems.

questions.prompt: A supply team divides 96 bolts equally among 8 tool kits. How many bolts go into each kit?
questions.explanation: Divide 96 by 8. Each tool kit receives 12 bolts.

questions.prompt: A delivery vehicle travels 180 miles in 3 hours at a steady speed. What is its average speed?
questions.explanation: Average speed equals distance divided by time: 180 ÷ 3 = 60 mph.

topics.title: Word Knowledge
topics.description: Practice synonyms and vocabulary in context.

questions.prompt: In the sentence "The technician was meticulous when checking each connection," meticulous most nearly means:
questions.explanation: Meticulous describes someone who gives careful attention to detail.
If something is scarce, there is not much of it available.

topics.title: Paragraph Comprehension
topics.description: Identify main ideas and supporting details.

questions.prompt: Passage: The neighborhood library added Saturday hours because weekday attendance had increased. Staff hope the extra day will help working families visit. Why did the library extend its schedule?
options: To make visits easier for more people
questions.explanation: The passage says Saturday hours respond to demand and help working families visit.

questions.prompt: Passage: Before using the lab, workers inspect equipment, record damaged items, and report problems. This routine helps prevent interruptions and injuries. What is the main purpose of the routine?
questions.explanation: The checklist catches problems early and lowers risk to people and equipment.

topics.title: Mathematics Knowledge
topics.description: Review algebra, geometry, and number sense.

questions.prompt: What is the area of a triangle with a base of 10 units and a height of 7 units?
questions.explanation: Triangle area is one-half times base times height: (10 × 7) ÷ 2 = 35.
